title: A word that is rejected: every guess fails
notes: abab is not a palindrome. Every guess of the middle dies: a symbol does not match the top of the stack, or q2 reaches $ with input still to read. When the queue is empty no branch is left, and the machine rejects.
ops: start q0; accept q0 q3; q0 eps, eps -> q1 $; q1 a, eps -> q1 a; q1 b, eps -> q1 b; q1 eps, eps -> q2 eps; q2 a, a -> q2 eps; q2 b, b -> q2 eps; q2 eps, $ -> q3 eps
